Wind gust uses the maximum NWS grid windGust overlapping the same 24-hour window. Minimum temperature uses NWS hourly grid temperature through 72 hours. Snow and ice use NWS grid accumulation intervals conservatively; non-zero partial boundary intervals are unavailable rather than prorated.
